app_fee.value: The Graduate School says the fee varies by program; see each program record.

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate School page does not state a waiver rule; see each program record.
fee_waiver.quote: A nonrefundable application fee is required for each program you apply to.

gre_general.value: Set by each program; see the program records.
gre_general.quote: Not all programs require test scores.

toefl_min.value: University minimum is TOEFL iBT 79 (4 on the new 1-6 scale); departments may ask for more.
toefl_min.quote: Although departments may require higher scores, the university's official minimum score for the TOEFL is: | 79 TOEFL IBT (including Home and Paper Editions)

ielts_min.value: University minimum is IELTS Academic 6.5 overall; departments may ask for more.
ielts_min.quote: Although departments may require higher scores, the university's official minimum score for the IELTS is 6.5

english_waiver.value: The automatic exemption covers citizens educated in English medium in a listed set of countries; India is not on it. Only a department can petition for an exception, in rare cases.
english_waiver.quote: Students who are citizens of, and who were educated in the English medium from Antigua and Barbuda, Australia, The Bahamas | In rare circumstances, UB academic programs (the UB department, not the applicant/student) may petition the Office of International Admissions for an ELP waiver/exception.

notes: Fees and test policies differ by school; engineering programs (SEAS) charge $100, Jacobs medical-school programs $85.
